Repaint image 2 in the painting language of image 1. IMAGE 1 IS THE PRIMARY STYLE AUTHORITY, image 2 ONLY identifies the character, costume, pose and principal props. Match image 1's clearly Japanese anime drawing, economical facial anatomy, opaque matte painted color planes, coherent directional hair strokes, broad shadow groups with structured smaller angular brush marks. Faces and skin calm and delicately anime, cloth and hair have firmer painted edges. Keep painterly volume and meaningful fold structure: neither glossy over-rendered illustration nor flat cel-shaded simplification. Eliminate random micro-wrinkles, noisy fragmented glints and decorative surface mottling. Gold trim should be a few readable painted strokes rather than reflective jewel-like filigree. Do not copy image 1's identity or black dress.
